# tomlc17 (vendored)

Upstream: https://github.com/cktan/tomlc17  
License: MIT (see `LICENSE`)

**Build copy used by the SDL kitty driver:**  
`third_party/SDL/src/video/kitty/tomlc17/` (`tomlc17.c` / `tomlc17.h` / `LICENSE`)

This directory mirrors the same files for discovery next to other parent `third_party/` deps. Prefer editing the SDL-tree copy (or keep both in sync).

Only `tomlc17.c` / `tomlc17.h` are required at build time.
